thread:
Noor: Quick PR to update Argent8b model card: add `argent8b-quant`, fix sequence limits, and include Go + curl SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3120 :sparkles:
Carlos: Nice. What changed on the limits?
Noor: Upstream model stated 2048 but runtime supports practical 4096 with KV cache for single-stream cases. I clarified the table and added a footnote about soft truncation when cache isn't enabled.
Jen: Can you also add a one-line recommended deployment column (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)? That helps readers pick quickly.
Noor: Added it. Kept values one-word and added a footnote pointing to the sizing guide.
Oren: For embeddings, list both dims (1024, 256-lite) and explain that lite requires sharding/aggregation.
Noor: Included both and a short example `curl` that shows how to parse the emb vector with jq.
Carlos: Add a quantized variant compatibility note: "Quantized variants can exhibit minor tokenization variance; validate on your prompt set." Keep concise.
Noor: Done. Fixed a broken anchor to `/docs/limits#sequence-behavior` while I was at it.
docs-bot: CI started for PR #3120  snippet-tests + docs-lint.
Noor: CI passed snippet-tests, docs-lint had a table width warning which I tightened and pushed.
docs-bot: All checks green. :white_check_mark:
Carlos: LGTM, nice work. Please add a short changelog line in docs/changes.md before merging.
Noor: Will do — thanks everyone! :tada:
